title: Ship / scale — reference-based family proposal
authority: ASSET-PROMPTS.md: S01 freight ship; motion-required family gate
Accepted C01 and connected handoff checkpoint
identity: Long, realistic container vessel with stern bridge and bow downward in the eventual overhead scene. One persistent C01; orderly silver/navy/blue cargo.

inputs.title: Bow-quarter identity master
inputs.view: Elevated bow-quarter oblique; full vessel, bow toward lower right, stern bridge visible. This is a three-quarter view, not a straight-down overhead or roof-only plate.
inputs.purpose: Resolve bow profile, deck/container arrangement, bridge, glazing, fittings and material family together.
inputs.gate: Generate only after direction/method and generation allowance are approved; stop for S01 static identity review.
inputs.prompt: Create one photorealistic modern container freight ship following the supplied walkthrough vessel: long low hull, pointed bow, stern bridge and orderly longitudinal deck bays. Match the supplied ship reference in hull length-to-beam (approximately 5:1 in the near-overhead full-vessel frame), bow/stern contours, freeboard, stern-bridge footprint and height, deck coverage, cargo bay count and spacing. Do not use an arbitrary 120 m by 18 m hull or a short, wide toy silhouette. Preserve the approved lift, truck and jet family treatment: shared Pegasoft carbon #11151B, restrained blue #147DFF accents, natural brushed metal, clear glass and credible physical surface detail. Keep the reference geometry distinct from the Pegasoft palette. Keep the full stern-to-bow silhouette visible with comfortable margin. Use satin marine-painted Pegasoft carbon #11151B for the main hull and painted structure; use a restrained #147DFF blue waterline band and selected deck-fitting accents. The bridge housing is cool porcelain #EDF2F7 with carbon window frames, clear lightly cool-tinted glazing and a coherent interior. Use neutral brushed silver/titanium rails, ladders, lashing hardware, anchors and fittings. Keep natural metal highlights and controlled cool studio light; no plastic-looking smoothing, toy proportions, exaggerated bevels or block cab substitute. Arrange consistent silver, deep navy #061E3B and restrained blue #147DFF 40-foot container stacks in regular fore-to-aft bays. Preserve the supplied approved silver C01 identity, corrugation, roof proportions and corner construction for one centered longitudinal anchor container on the deck. Keep bridge, hull, deck hardware and bay layout coherent across every family view. Include credible hatch coamings, narrow walkways, lashing bridges, fine railings and bow/stern equipment. Leave clean hull areas for externally applied Pegasoft lettering. Isolate the complete vessel on transparency: no water, wake, clouds, ground plane, people, logos, generated text, registration, baked shadows, decorative orange/gold/purple or bright rainbow containers. Elevated bow-quarter oblique; full vessel, bow toward lower right, stern bridge visible. This is a three-quarter view, not a straight-down overhead or roof-only plate. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

output.resolution: Select a supported size during fresh schema/price preflight before submission.

excluded_inputs: extra end or alternate oblique views

materials.finish: Satin marine paint, readable fine grain and shaped metal surfaces; shared structural finish.
Restrained painted blue band and accent areas; placement consistent in both views.
Cool porcelain paint, carbon frames, real clear glass and coherent interior.
Approved C01 corrugation and fittings; hero cargo remains the exact C01 model.
Distinct brushed metal, natural highlights; no warm decorative spill.
Separate later section layers; not painted hull and not part of this input batch.

mandatory_carbon_clause: All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

dimensions.hero_container: Exact existing C01, reference nominal length 12.192 m; reuse approved geometry and scale.

reference_proportions.interpretation: Approximately 5:1 in this near-overhead source frame. Manual screen estimate excludes wake; not a recovered engineering dimension. Other frames may have perspective foreshortening.
reference_proportions.generation_rule: Match the reference silhouette and bay arrangement; aim at approximately 5:1 length-to-beam in the model overhead inspection, not the old 120/18 target. Resolve final metric length/beam around exact C01 dimensions without stretching cargo.

dimensions.absolute_vessel_dimensions: Not supplied by the reference. Derive coherent metric length, beam, freeboard, bow/stern extent, bridge size and cargo layout from reference proportions and unchanged C01 support footprint; record final values before model production.
dimensions.rule: Reference proportions take precedence over arbitrary hull targets. Preserve C01 scale and all accepted asset dimensions; never shorten/widen the hull or resize cargo to fit a shot.

model_method.proposed: Local dimensioned Three.js solid geometry and GLB export, following the accepted container/truck construction approach; static images guide identity, not image facades.
model_method.provider: No image-to-3D provider or new 3D production service proposed.
assemblies: Shaped closed hull, bow and stern with continuous surface normals
Solid deck/hatch coamings and separate cargo supports
Stern bridge with real glazing, consistent interior and railings
Separate lashing bridges, ladders, walkways, anchors and fittings
One persistent exact C01 at the aligned top-deck anchor
Repeated cargo with shared geometry/materials; background detail optimization reviewed against approved identity
model_method.review: Orbit, zoom, bow/stern, sides, deck, bridge and actual overhead journey view before section motion; closed-volume and opening audit.
model_method.fidelity: Photographic identity and material detail must match accepted S01/S02; neither a toy-like box hull nor texture-on-flat-plane construction qualifies.
model_method.budget: Measure model size/draw calls and prepare reviewed background LOD/instances; preserve the exact hero C01.

motion_contract.road_to_deck: Continue the accepted final overhead truck/container axis. Deck enters under the road while C01 roof position, silhouette and orientation align. Road/truck layers clear only with stable deck support; no free-space slide or unexplained cargo scale change.
motion_contract.transfer: Preserve C01 world pose at ownership change. Treat this as a reference-inspired visual handoff, not a claim of real at-sea loading mechanics.
motion_contract.camera: One deterministic overhead target/orientation and monotonic pullback; no bounds-based auto-fit, damped second controller, height bob or pose reset. Bow points downward.
motion_contract.copy: Built to work at scale. Five planned pillars remain draft: One accountable team, Clear project visibility, Engineered foundations, Transparent scope, Fast decisions. Reveal/pin against reference landmarks after model approval.
motion_contract.wake: Wake derives from stern transform and vessel axis; never drifts independently as the camera pulls back.
motion_contract.exit: Later layered clouds occlude the receding ship and connect to the already accepted jet/trust crossing. Atmosphere is a separate review/batch.
verification: Source aspect, laptop and mobile framing
Normal/quarter playback, pause, forward/reverse native scroll
Container pose/scale continuity and support at the boundary
Static camera orientation and monotonic distance throughout pullback
Stable deck materials/no flicker, stern-bound wake
Required silhouette/bridge/rail/cargo detail matches static family

provider_preflight.required: Read live schema, supported resolution/transparency and configured quote; confirm allowance before paid submission.

approval_requested: Ship identity, material-role placement and proposed non-carbon bridge/blue accents
Two-image input manifest and exact prompts
Local solid-geometry/GLB model method and metric scale rule
Road-to-deck, pullback, wake and later cloud/jet motion contract
stop_condition: Present this proposal for review. Do not generate images, build the ship model, change accepted handoff motion or integrate production in this step.

style_references.use: Approved Pegasoft paint, material separation, cool lighting and realistic surface/detail treatment; not vessel geometry.
Approved Pegasoft paint, material separation, cool lighting and realistic surface/detail treatment; not vessel geometry.
Approved Pegasoft paint, material separation, cool lighting and realistic surface/detail treatment; not vessel geometry.

S01: Compare full hull silhouette, roughly 5:1 projected proportions and deck/bridge placement with source; perspective must not disguise a short or overly wide hull.
Check Pegasoft carbon/blue placement against supplied approved family references, preserving separate metal/glass roles.

Inspect at full resolution: seams, fittings, railings, lashing hardware, glazed bridge/interior, believable grain/reflections; reject melted details, toy bevels, plastic surfaces and inconsistent cargo.
Record dimensions/proportion findings; stop for personal identity approval before S02.
S02: Use accepted S01 as the identity source. Preserve hull length/beam, freeboard, bow/stern contours, bridge and cargo order exactly.
Compare side silhouette and scale against accepted S01/reference; no redesign, added deck rows, shortened hull or changed paint placement.
Inspect detail/material realism independently; stop for coherent static family approval before modelling.
per_asset_review.failure_policy: Record discrepancies and propose the smallest correction; do not accept weak realism through technical checks or automatically generate retries/variants.
